prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore` to restore soft-deleted episodes and their cuts at their prior position, added Undo action support to the toast and Episodes page in both English and Korean, updated `CHANGELOG.md`, and added tests in `backend/tests/test_episode_restore.py` (10 backend tests and `npx tsc --noEmit` pass).

+def duplicate_episode(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Duplicate an episode and all its cuts within the same project.
+    Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it.
+    """
+    episode = _get_episode_for_member(session, episode_id, current_user_id)
+
+    ordered_episodes = _get_ordered_episodes(session, episode.project_id)
+    orig_index = next((i for i, ep in enumerate(ordered_episodes) if ep.id == episode.id), len(ordered_episodes) - 1)
+
+    new_episode = Episode(
+        project_id=episode.project_id,
+        title=f"{episode.title} (Copy)",
+        story_summary=episode.story_summary,
+        episode_order=orig_index + 2,
+        status="ready" if episode.status == "generating" else episode.status,
+        background_info=episode.background_info,
+        character_outfits=copy.deepcopy(episode.character_outfits) if episode.character_outfits is not None else {},
+        character_reference_board_urls=list(episode.character_reference_board_urls) if episode.character_reference_board_urls else [],
+    )
+    ordered_episodes.insert(orig_index + 1, new_episode)
+    _renumber_episodes(session, ordered_episodes)
+    session.flush()
+
+    cuts = session.exec(
+        select(StoryCut)
+        .where(StoryCut.episode_id == episode.id)
+        .order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)
+    ).all()
+
+    first_cut_image_url = None
+    for cut in cuts:
+        new_cut = StoryCut(
+            episode_id=new_episode.id,
+            cut_order=cut.cut_order,
+            script=cut.script,
+            location=cut.location,
+            time_of_day=cut.time_of_day,
+            transition_ref=cut.transition_ref,
+            selected_layout=cut.selected_layout,
+            aspect_ratio=cut.aspect_ratio,
+            image_path=cut.image_path,
+            image_asset_id=cut.image_asset_id,
+            status="idle" if cut.status == "generating" else cut.status,
+            dialogues=copy.deepcopy(cut.dialogues) if cut.dialogues is not None else [],
+            appearing_characters=copy.deepcopy(cut.appearing_characters) if cut.appearing_characters is not None else [],
+            embedding=list(cut.embedding) if cut.embedding is not None else None,
+            refer_prev_cut=cut.refer_prev_cut,
+        )
+        session.add(new_cut)
+        if first_cut_image_url is None and new_cut.image_path:
+            first_cut_image_url = _format_cut_image_url(new_cut.image_path)
+
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(new_episode)
+
+    return _episode_out_dict(new_episode, first_cut_image_url)
+

+def restore_episode(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Restore a soft-deleted episode to its previous position in the project.
+    Only members of the episode's workspace may restore it.
+    """
+    episode = _get_episode_for_member(session, episode_id, current_user_id, include_deleted=True)
+
+    if episode.deleted_at is not None:
+        active_episodes = _get_ordered_episodes(session, episode.project_id)
+        insert_idx = max(0, min(episode.episode_order - 1, len(active_episodes)))
+        episode.deleted_at = None
+        active_episodes.insert(insert_idx, episode)
+        _renumber_episodes(session, active_episodes)
+        session.commit()
+        session.refresh(episode)
+
+    first_cut = session.exec(
+        select(StoryCut)
+        .where(StoryCut.episode_id == episode.id)
+        .where(StoryCut.image_path != None)
+        .order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)
+        .limit(1)
+    ).first()
+    first_cut_image_url = _format_cut_image_url(first_cut.image_path) if first_cut else None
+
+    return _episode_out_dict(episode, first_cut_image_url)

+            script="Close-up of Hana holding an umbrella.",
+            selected_layout="closeup",
+            aspect_ratio="1:1",
+            dialogues=[{"speaker": "Hana", "text": "Who's there?"}],

+            image_path="cuts/ep1/cut2.png",

+def test_duplicate_episode_copies_metadata_and_cuts_in_order(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id, ep1_id = _create_project_and_episode(client, h)
+
+    dup_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1_id}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert dup_resp.status_code == 200, dup_resp.text
+    dup = dup_resp.json()
+
+    assert dup["id"] != ep1_id
+    assert dup["project_id"] == project_id
+    assert dup["title"] != "Episode 1"
+    assert "Episode 1" in dup["title"]
+    assert "copy" in dup["title"].lower()
+    assert dup["story_summary"] == "A mysterious encounter at the station."
+    assert dup["episode_order"] == 2  # right after Episode 1
+    assert dup["first_cut_image"].endswith("cuts/ep1/cut1.png")
+
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project_id}", headers=h).json()

+def test_restore_deleted_episode_brings_back_cuts_and_position(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id, ep1_id, ep2_id, ep3_id = _setup_three_episodes(client, h)
+
+    # Delete middle episode
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2_id}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    listed_after_delete = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project_id}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(ep["id"], ep["episode_order"]) for ep in listed_after_delete] == [
+        (ep1_id, 1),
+        (ep3_id, 2),
+    ]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2_id}", headers=h).status_code == 404
+
+    # Restore Ep 2 -> comes back at 2, Ep 3 moves down to 3
+    restore_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2_id}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert restore_resp.status_code == 200, restore_resp.text
+    restored = restore_resp.json()
+    assert restored["id"] == ep2_id
+    assert restored["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert restored["story_summary"] == "Middle"
+    assert restored["first_cut_image"].endswith("cuts/ep2/cut1.png")
+
+    listed_after_restore = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project_id}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(ep["id"], ep["episode_order"]) for ep in listed_after_restore] == [
+        (ep1_id, 1),
+        (ep2_id, 2),
+        (ep3_id, 3),
+    ]
+
+    cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2_id}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(cuts) == 1
+    assert cuts[0]["script"] == "Ep 2 cut 1"
+    assert cuts[0]["dialogues"] == [{"speaker": "Hero", "text": "Wait!"}]
+

+
+    # Non-member sees 404

+    # Unauthenticated returns 401
